title.zh: 修订第128号法案（经第630号法案修订），将《省政府法》适用于Misamis省，并降低该省督察兼财务主管职位薪酬的法案
title.en: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-EIGHT, EXTENDING THE PROVISIONS OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT' ACT TO THE PROVINCE OF MISAMIS, AS AMENDED BY ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY, BY DECREASING THE SALARY ATTACHED TO THE POSITION OF SUPERVISOR-TREASURER OF THE PROVINCE OF MISAMIS.
title.orig: AN ACT AMENDING ACT NUMBERED ONE HUNDRED AND TWENTY-EIGHT, EXTENDING THE PROVISIONS OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT' ACT TO THE PROVINCE OF MISAMIS, AS AMENDED BY ACT NUMBERED SIX HUNDRED AND THIRTY, BY DECREASING THE SALARY ATTACHED TO THE POSITION OF SUPERVISOR-TREASURER OF THE PROVINCE OF MISAMIS.
title.vi: Luật sửa đổi Đạo luật số 128, đã được sửa đổi bởi Đạo luật số 630, áp dụng Đạo luật Chính quyền tỉnh tại Misamis và giảm lương chức vụ giám sát kiêm thủ quỹ tỉnh
title.th: พระราชบัญญัติแก้ไขกฎหมายเลขที่ 128 ซึ่งแก้ไขโดยกฎหมายเลขที่ 630 ให้นำกฎหมายว่าด้วยรัฐบาลจังหวัดมาใช้กับ Misamis และลดเงินเดือนตำแหน่งผู้ตรวจการควบเหรัญญิกจังหวัด
title.id: Undang-Undang mengubah Undang-Undang Nomor 128 sebagaimana diubah oleh Nomor 630, memberlakukan Undang-Undang Pemerintahan Provinsi di Misamis dan mengurangi gaji jabatan pengawas merangkap bendahara provinsi
title.ms: Akta meminda Akta No. 128 sebagaimana dipinda oleh Akta No. 630, memperluas Akta Kerajaan Wilayah kepada Misamis dan mengurangkan gaji jawatan penyelia merangkap bendahari wilayah

text.en:
Section two of Act Numbered One hundred and twenty-eight, extending the provisions of the
Provincial Government Act to the Province of Misamis, as amended by Act Numbered Six hundred and
thirty, is hereby amended by decreasing the salary of the provincial supervisor-treasurer to two thousand
dollars per annum, in money of the United States.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 29, 1901.
